card.name: Modifier words before a quality adjective
card.fires_on: Small modifier words (no, well, readily, easily, perfect) that sit just before an adjective or participle like specific, documented, available or defined. Most often in "There is no specific antidote".

modes.label: No before specific antidote
modes.description: The word "no" in the overdose treatment phrase, right before "specific antidote".

modes.description: Adverbs like well, easily or readily that precede a describing word such as documented, defined or available.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word "special" and "specific"-like words next, and away from copy or create words.
card.plain: It marks a small word like "no" or "well" that is about to be followed by a word like "specific" or "documented".
